name: Jefferson City Chess Club
notes: You are invited to chess night every normal Tuesday night (6-9pm) at the Cork & Board (124 East High Street, Jefferson City, MO 65101). Normally there is a US Chess Federation rated Game in 10 minutes chess tournament that starts at 6:30pm. Saturday November 20, 2021 there is a US Chess Federation rated Game in 40 minutes chess tournament and a free workshop for kids to learn how to play chess from 8am to 1pm at the Cork & Board. There will be about 10 Saturday tournaments in a year in either Jefferson City or Fulton, MO. If you want to play tournament or casual games or take chess lessons in person in or near Jefferson City, MO at a different place, day, or time contact me pennycheckmate.

name: 29 Palms Chess Club
notes: About Twentynine Palms Chess Club Welcome to the Twentynine Palms Chess Club, a community for chess enthusiasts in and around Twentynine Palms! We proudly serve both local residents and military personnel stationed at the Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center. Whether you live in the area or have a deep appreciation for Twentynine Palms, we invite you to join our growing community of chess players. Our goal is to foster a friendly and competitive chess environment where members can improve their skills and enjoy the game. Weather permitting, we hope to host weekly or monthly in-person meetings at local parks like Knotts Sky Park or Luckie Park, depending on interest and participation. No matter your skill level, you’re welcome here. Come play, learn, and connect with fellow chess lovers as we build a vibrant chess scene in Twentynine Palms!

name: Columbus Mulligan Chess Club
notes: A place where anyone is welcome to come, sip on a drink, relax, and not feel intimidated. Like the old English Pub, except with hot chocolate/coffee instead of beer, and chess instead of darts. Players of all strengths participate. The more experienced players tend to take a mentoring/teaching role to the less experienced players. It is a place where taking a move back is not frowned upon, thus the name of the club being 'The Mulligan Chess Club' (mulligan being a golf term for hitting the ball again, without a penalty, if you did not like your shot). We meet every Saturday from 2 PM to 7 PM at: Avery Muirfield Panera 6665 Perimeter Loop Rd Dublin, OH 43017 Join this free chess club at https://www.meetup.com/mulligan-columbus-chess-club/
